constraints: Export order follows the entry order of fields/objects on the current output form; use an output form containing only what you want exported (buttons and other extraneous objects should not be placed on it; subform objects are ignored).
An On Load event is sent to the output form method for each exported record.
If document is an empty string, the standard save-file dialog is displayed; canceling it sets OK to 0.
Uses the UTF-8 character set by default; since SYLK documents typically use ISO-8859-1, use USE CHARACTER SET to set the appropriate character set.
Default field delimiter is tab (code 9); default record delimiter is carriage return, platform-dependent.
Sets OK to 1 on success, 0 if canceled or an error occurred; the progress thermometer can be hidden with MESSAGES OFF.

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Exports the current selection of aTable (or the default table) to a SYLK document, using the current output form to determine which fields/objects are written.
